name: instanode CI — pr-smoke failing on main (P1)
description: P1 (user-visible, recoverable) on ANY InstantCITestRun{suite='pr-smoke', branch='main', result='fail'} — the real-backend UI smoke (instanode-web/.github/workflows/e2e-pr-smoke.yml) mints a cohort account and drives the critical journeys (login round-trip, resources list, one provision, one deploy, billing render) against the real api. A fail ON MAIN means a UI↔API contract just broke post-merge (the 2026-05-29 login-broke class the whole CI integration plan targets) — it ran green on the PR but reds against current main, so the next deploy would ship broken. Scoped to branch='main' (a PR-branch pr-smoke fail is the PR author's to fix and is covered by the ci-failure-rate-spike P2). Triage: the run uploads a Playwright trace; the InstantCITestFailure event carries failed_step + log_url. The suite only emits when its mint token is configured (RUN=1). Source: instanode-web/.github/workflows/e2e-pr-smoke.yml + .github/actions/nr-ci-event.

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM InstantCITestRun WHERE suite = 'pr-smoke' AND branch = 'main' AND result = 'fail'
